verdict.rationale: ComplyAdvantage's docs say you can download the OpenAPI (Swagger) schema alongside a Postman collection. A hands-on probe fetched the spec unauthenticated (HTTP 200) at /openapi/mesh-api.json and parsed it as OpenAPI 3.0.3 covering customer, case, audit, export and transaction resources. The 404s at conventional paths only show the spec is not at a well-known location; they do not contradict that it is downloadable. Missing for 10: discoverability at a standard or well-known OpenAPI path (openapi.json, .well-known/openapi.json all returned 404).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)

citations.quote: you can download the OpenAPI ("Swagger") schema
Observed unauthenticated documentation GET HTTP 200; parsed OpenAPI 3.0.3.
